title: PAR-07/S8 malformed in-range DataStorage record-boundary control
subplan: PAR-07/S8 existing DataStorage association and bounds owner

change.summary: Extended the existing generated AC1027 DataStorage profile with an in-range, header-shaped DataIndex target whose record-local offset lands inside a neighboring valid payload. The parser reports structural invalidity and disables replay, withholds the overlapping valid/fake record pair, and preserves exact bytes for two independently bounded records. No heuristic boundary recovery was added.

overlapping valid record is not published
section is structurally invalid and not replayable
two independently bounded neighboring records retain exact payload bytes
